lesson.easy_flower.title: Easy Flower
lesson.easy_flower.summary: Build a cheerful flower from a round center, a whole group of petals, then a stem and leaves.
lesson.easy_flower.step.center: Begin with one small circle for the middle of the flower.
lesson.easy_flower.help.center_hint: Keep this circle smaller than the big sun you drew before.
lesson.easy_flower.step.petals: Watch the petals bloom as a group around the center, then make your own petal ring.
lesson.easy_flower.help.petals_hint: Each petal touches the flower center and points outward.
lesson.easy_flower.step.stem_and_leaves: Finish with one stem and two simple leaves growing from the sides.
lesson.easy_flower.complete.drawing: Beautiful! Your flower grew from simple shapes into a complete picture.
